notes.title: version 1.4.1 (build f2c/f2d) - 64bit support + bugfix patch
notes.notes:
We have released a moderate bugfix patch!  64bit version of the game is now available; you can choose which version to use (64bit version is generally recommended).

[h2]version 1.4.1, build f2c/f2d[/h2]

[h3]Added/changed features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 64bit support
[list]
[*] This is aimed to solve various problems that (seem to) stem from memory usage limitation of 32bit application, such as ending sequence not starting properly, broken fonts for higher game resolution setting, Steam Game Recording feature crashing the game, etc.
[*] We recommend playing with 64bit version unless you have problems with it or have a specific reason to use 32bit version.
[/list]
[*] Replaced "FPS Limit" setting with "FPS Control"
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Side Scenario #1: Fixed the issue where a dagger afterimage randomly appears at the center of dance field in certain situation
[*] Side Scenario #1: Corrected a drawing mistake in ending sequence
[*] Side Scenario #1: Fixed glitchy behavior that occurs after defeating boss attack right after using Perfect Freeze
[*] Fixed various issues related to practice mode and Side Scenario #1:
[list]
[*] Decoys will no longer stay between practice mode attempts
[*] Stage 2 and 4 boss: Fixed the issue where camera scroll position not being reset while playing "All Attacks"
[*] Stage 4 Boss, Boss Attack #6: Fixed the issue where various elements of the attack lingers if you fail or choose to retry
[*] Stage 4 Boss, Boss Attack #7: Fixed the issue where damage resistance of the boss won't return back to normal after completing it or failing/retrying after the 2nd phase
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]version 1.4.1.1, build f32/f33[/h2]

[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Side Scenario #1: Fixed the issue where the decoy's support attack that didn't hit enemy accumulate outside the screen causing problems
[/list]

[h2]version 1.4.1.2, build f3b/f3c[/h2]

[h3]Bugfix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Side Scenario #1: Fixed the CTD while playing tutorial (64bit version only)
[/list]

Rumia is cute! ːyoidan_rumiaː

- tripper

notes.title: version 1.4.0 (build ec9) - Cirno Update! + The Super Strong Sale
notes.notes:
Finally, Cirno's Scenario (Side Scenario #1) is here!  It was supposed to be out last year but we failed to do so.  I have to admit that I was too optimistic and naïve - I hope the new content is worth the long wait for you.


[h2]version 1.4.0, build ec9[/h2]

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Side Scenario #1, Cirno's Story
[list]
[*] Unlocked by defeating 1st stage boss in scenario #2.
[*] 4 stages, 8(9) new music tracks
[/list]
[*] Added 11 achievements
[list]
[*] 10 achievements related to the new scenario
[*] 1 achievement related to the practice mode
[/list]
[*] Added some extra pictures for completing the boss rush
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated English translation
[list]
[*] For various reasons and circumstances we have decided to respectfully change the translator.
[*] If you liked the translation in previous versions - we're sorry :(
[/list]
[*] Fixed issues and a potential softlock that can occur after playing the boss rush.
[/list]


[h3]Unlocking the new scenario[/h3]
The new scenario is unlocked by defeating the first boss in scenario #2.  If you have already played  the scenario (and beaten her) you should see the "Scenario unlocked" screen.
For people who want to play the new scenario without playing the other, I've decided to [spoiler]add a hidden command to unlock all scenarios - enter the scenario selection screen first and press the following command: "Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, Cancel, OK"[/spoiler].
* Please note that all scenarios besides #1 are designed for people who already know how this game work in general, so skipping #1 entirely isn't exactly recommended!



[h2]THE SUPER STRONG SALE[/h2]

This is the first major update for Steam version of Yoiyami Dancers - to celebrate, we've decided to launch a special sale - let's call it THE SUPER STRONG SALE (because it's Cirno) - with higher-than-usual discount, 50% off!  If you've been interested in this game, or have friends that are interested - please consider the purchase ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951839/fdfd2760407fc7c1a96350864cdb7299c56271b7.png[/img]

* Note: The soundtrack is also on sale but it does not (and probably will not) contain the tracks from the update - please bear this in mind before making the purchase.



[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Next major update for Yoiyami Dancers would be Scenario #3, but for the time being we will mainly focus on working on other projects and porting the update to other platforms(eg. Switch and PS4).
This means the next major update might take a while to come out, again; after all the release of this update took more than 2 years...  However I can assure you that we have absolutely no intention of "abandoning" this game!  I believe that there are still so many fun things that can be done using the foundation of Yoiyami Dancers.
For now we hope you enjoy the update - and our Danmaku Dancing journey.



Rumia is cute⚫️👍

- tripper

notes.title: version 1.3.4 (build c8d) - Addressing Player Feedbacks
notes.notes:
It's been a REALLY long time, more than a year has passed since we've released the soundtrack and version 1.3.3!

This update patch (version 1.3.4) is mainly about addressing player feedbacks.
Both two of us developers do read Steam game reviews (and discussions page) - long or short, positive or negative, funny or serious - every single one of them!  Unfortunately it doesn't mean that every feedback and opinion can be addressed, but we'll try our best as much as we reasonably can.




[h2]version 1.3.4, build c8d[/h2]

[h3]Added Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Audio Mode" in config screen: you can select audio API used for playing audio. 
[list]
[*] In most cases "Auto" should work with no problem - try other options if the audio isn't properly played.
[/list]
[*] Added "Audio Offset", "Video Offset" and "Automatic calibration" in config screen: you can now customize or calibrate rhythm bar timings.
[list]
[*] This game should be playable with default settings, but if your audio device has a noticeable lag or you feel the timings are off - try this one!
[/list]
[*] Added "Beat Display" in config screen: if enabled, you can see how long your input will be accepted for each turn.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the bullet grazing tutorial less annoying.
[list]
[*] The required inputs to beat fairies were too complex for beginners (mostly due to them constantly trying to avoid Rumia's attack), and it just wasn't a very good tutorial.
[/list]
[*] Scenario #1, Stage 3 Boss, Boss Attack #3: Now the boss gives you a hint if you get hit too many times in the attack or get the game over screen twice or more.
[*] Jingles are now played using BGM volume setting instead of SFX volume.
[list]
[*] If you have BGM volume set to low and SFX volume set to high, unlocking something could jumpscare you with a LOUD sound.  Now it shouldn't.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rhythm bars flashing on player input are drawn left and right reversed.
[list]
[*] This quirk might have been confusing players trying to figure out whether their inputs are early or late compared to exact timings by looking at the flashing bars.
[/list]
[/list]




[h2]Regarding the unofficial translation mod:[/h2]

To our surprise, an unofficial Chinese translation mod have been created by Chinese players (you can access the website through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1998530/discussions/0/4133808904484195592/]this thread in Discussions page[/url]).  First of all we'd like to send our gratitude to mod developers - thank you so much!
Unfortunately however, mods will generally stop working if the developer pushes an update to the game and it's very likely that the translation mod no longer works for the current version.  (Due to how the game assets are handled, I can imagine that our games are pretty unfriendly to create unofficial translation mods)
We have made the previous version (version 1.3.3) available through Steam Beta Branch feature, so play with this version if needed.  From now on we plan to provide access to legacy versions each time we push an update.


[Chinese DeepL translation (from Japanese):]
令人惊喜的是，一位志愿者创建了一个非官方的中文翻译模块（[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1998530/discussions/0/4133808904484195592/]您可以从本主题访问发布者[/url]）。非常感谢！
不幸的是，当游戏开发者更新游戏时，志愿者制作的 MOD 一般都无法使用，因此我们认为这个补丁将使这个 MOD 无法使用。 (特别是，我们认为由于资产管理方式的原因，我们的游戏对 MOD 制作者完全不友好：......）
我们已通过 Steam 的测试版分支功能提供了之前的版本 “1.3.3 版”，因此在玩 MOD 时，如有必要，请使用该版本。今后更新时，我们将继续通过测试分支功能提供尽可能多的旧版本。




[h2]Regarding the next update:[/h2]

Currently we're actively working on the next major update for Yoiyami Dancers and it's planned to be released by the end of this year.  We're really sorry that no playable character has been added to the game despite the store description and the fact that more than 1.5 years have passed since Steam release.  We're trying to make something that's fresh and fun even for Yoiyami Dancers veterans, and we hope you'll enjoy the Danmaku Dancing once again after the update is out.
Stay tuned.

notes.title: version 1.3.2 (build b26) - bugfix + some options
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a while since the last update!   Version 1.3.2 is out now.


[h2]version 1.3.2, build b26[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can choose the enemies' HP bar position and colors in config screen.  Old looks can be replicated by "HPBar Style: Type D" + "HPBar Color: Type A".
[*]Added control guide for the menu, in the bottom-right corner.  Can be disabled from the config screen.
[*]In the "Mastery Medals" screen, the medals you collected in other difficulty ranks are now highlighted.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed that the option "Image Quality: Economy" [b][i]didn't do anything at all[/i][/b]; the game loaded the uncompressed image assets regardless of the option, not reducing VRAM usage. (I've instructed some people to use the option before realizing this. I'm so sorry!)
[*] Scenario #1, Stage 3 boss, Boss Attack #3: Fixed the bug where Rumia temporarily duplicates herself if you use RETRY from the pause menu while you're dancing with the boss.
[*] Scenario #2, Stage 3 boss, Boss Attack #5: Fixed the bug that if you defeat the boss while there's a bomb fairy in the screen, the lit bomb will drop and potentially give you a double KO.
[*] Scenario #2, Stage 4 boss, Boss Attack #7: Fixed the bug where the bonus [P] items (from the combo attacks) sometimes go to the left even if the boss is in the left side of the screen.
[*] Removed the loading that happens during the talk scene after you beat stage 3 boss in scenario #2 bossrush.
[*] Fixed the bug where you can unlock the achievement "The Catharsis of Release" during the tutorial.
[*] Fixed the bug that using "Contract" item while having low HP and just enough Max HP can give you Game Over right away.
[*] Fixed the bug that if you start with "Starting Item: None", picking up any usable item can spawn "None" item in the screen.
[*] Fixed the bug where default controls with Steam Input enabled and with it disabled differs; "Charge" and "Use Item" buttons were swapped.
[*] Fixed some Japanese text typo.
[*] Fixed some English text typo.
[/list]

A lot of bugs were found through bug reports and gameplay streams.  Thank you so much!


[h2]Future updates[/h2]

We (tripper_room + Ikaikaiyu) are currently working on two things, mostly in the same priority; a new game project with a smaller scale and a new scenario for Yoiyami Dancers. I can't say anything concrete yet, but my current estimate is that both can be done within somewhere in 2023.


[h3]A new game project[/h3]

For the first time the team will be working on a game that does NOT feature Rumia as the main protagonist!  As I stated above it'll be a somewhat smaller game.  After distributing it through Dojin events in Japan, we aim to do proper English translation and port it to Steam within 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951839/0c72649911eaacd017b5bdebdc1b98640af7f65f.png[/img]


[h3]New scenario for Yoiyami Dancers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951839/861a04ae5aab80b6b1c5b927d79b01bd109d27b4.gif[/img]

All additional scenarios will be available as a free update.  Of course there are more scenarios planned (Rumia will come back as a protagonist properly), so stay tuned!


I hope you're having a great holiday.  Rumia is cute!

notes.title: Game Launched! + Addressing some problems
notes.notes:
Hello!  Steam version of Yoiyami Dancers has been released, and within a day we're already seeing so many people leaving reviews!  We're reading every one of them and we'll continue to do so as long as we reasonably can, so that we know what players think about the game and make it better.  Thank you very much for your support and honest opinions!


In this post I'd like to address some problems that got mentioned on reviews and threads.


[h2]Optimization[/h2]

A major problem has been reported where the game fails to load graphic assets and either freezes or goes into an unplayable state.
This problem stems from the fact that we weren't really thinking about users with low-end to mid-range computers enough during the game development, and this resulted in a pretty bad optimization.
We're definitely looking into the problem and addressing it, but it may take some time to do so.  We apologize for the inconvenience, especially to the people who bought the game and not being able to play it.

In the meantime we'll be changing the minimum system requirements on the store page, specifically Memory and Graphics, in hopes that less people are affected with this problem while we're preparing the fix.

Previously:
- Memory: 2 GB RAM
- Graphics: Shader Model 2.0 compatible, VRAM 512MB
From now on:
- Memory: 4 GB RAM
- Graphics: Shader Model 2.0 compatible, VRAM 2.5GB

(Please let us know if you satisfy these requirements and still the game fails to launch properly - or the opposite case of having below the requirements and the game running well)



[h2]Demo version[/h2]

We're preparing the demo version for this game.  For now the demo can be played until the stage 2 of scenario #1.
It should've been available on the day of release, and the problem above taught us the sheer importance of it.  The demo version should be available in a few days, depending on how quickly Valve accepts the build.



[h2]Resolution Settings[/h2]

Currently the game doesn't have a way to change window size or the resolution, and instead it has a single "FULLSCREEN - YES/NO" option in the config menu (with added fun of it requiring restarting the game!).  For a 2022 game it's almost unacceptable, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/hwsurvey/Steam-Hardware-Software-Survey-Welcome-to-Steam]considering that quite a few people use monitors larger than full-HD resolution[/url].

The following updates will add some more options around this, such as changing resolutions and toggle full-screen mode using a borderless window.  This feature was being worked on, however I couldn't finish it within time and we needed to release it without the feature.



That's it for today - again we appreciate your support!  I'll leave more countdown pictures here.

Rumia is cute!

- tripper
